text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rumble!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So many fans are watching me! That's
why! That's
why!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I have to run toward them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Agnes Digital! Agnes Digital is
dashing across this unconventional track
as the rain pours down
around her! She's
going, going, and...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's crossed the finish line! What an
irrefutable
finish! Agnes Digital has won
the autumn Tenno
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Pant... Wheeze... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ooohhh?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: WHOOOOOAAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: OHHHMMMMYYYYYY!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Yeeeaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
GH! GH! GH!
GHHHRRRAAARRRHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital screams, possessed by
exhilaration.
The joy coming over her is
clear, even through her
garbled words.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! This... cathartic feeling... I've
never felt
like this before...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I... beat my two idols... The ones I've
admired for
so long...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined I could do it myself.
That's why I
always turned to my oshis...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But now... I...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whooooaaa! What are you saying?
I-I
am—me?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, I should give you a token of my

appreciation for being my fan! How does
a strand
of hair from my tail sound?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Caught up in the excitement of the moment,
Agnes Digital tries to offer me
a baffling
keepsake as I pull her to the
winner's circle.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Th-th-th-thank you! I'm Agnes Digital!
And I'm...
actually just your typical
Umamusume fan...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And... watching their behinds—I mean running behind them is what got me here...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I hope you all get it! I'm no ordinary
runner, but I
am just an ordinary fan, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm just so... thankful... to be a part of
such
majesty and to be able to cross the
finish line at
its head...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But the reason I was able to win today is
because I'm not just me! I'm the
culmination of all the
runners that I've
ever met... Their very essence...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
All of the Umamusume who helped me
grow won
this race for me today.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So... from the very bottom of my heart...
Thank
you, everyone...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Umamusume are... a hundred times more... a thousand times more spectacular than I thought when I was a mere fan.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Today, we experienced a historical

anomaly.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In these poor conditions, I went on the
path best
known to me, and Doto went
on hers, but...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For Digital, the entire track was hers.
And, due to her wealth of experience,
she deftly chose the
easiest place to set
her feet.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It was a path shown to her by numerous
runners.
Her ability to follow that path...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Is the proof that she is a true
all-rounder. For
today only, I relinquish
my crown.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
By the way, I know I won and all today,
but did
you guys see Opera O?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Isn't she great? Her short hair sways so
gallantly with each step she takes. And
did you see how her
eyes narrowed back
in the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And Doto's bag! It's so perfect on her! The way it swings when she moves—kyah!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh! And also—even though she didn't run
today—my cute classic-year oshi too!
I really
hope I can run with her on dirt
one day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And there are still more and more
Umamusume out there overflowing with
charm. With the spotlight on me now on
this grand stage, I can't waste this
chance to talk about all of them!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So, please, everyone, stick with me till
the end!
Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Um, Agnes Digital... I think that's your
time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Getting overexcited during her speech,
she winds
up losing control of herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But that's Agnes Digital. The staff begin
to tug
the amazing All-Rounder off the
stage when...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait! Let me say one more thing! Just
one more
thing, pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I LOVE UMAMUSUMEEEEE!
